output.summary: An annual plant native to Central and East Asia. It has large heart-shaped leaves that release an odor when crushed and has long been grown in China for strong, jute-like fibre. Its leaves were traditionally eaten in Maldivian mas huni, while its seeds are eaten in China and Kashmir.
